title: Test Plan
description: A named, organized list of test suites to run together as one unit. A test plan only references suites by file path.

id.description: Stable identifier for this test plan.

name.description: Optional human-readable display label for the test plan (e.g. "Nightly Regression"), shown in results/UI. Purely cosmetic has no bearing on identity, unlike 'id'.

description.description: Optional free-text description of what this test plan covers.

test_suites.description: Ordered list of suite file paths (e.g. "checkout/smoke") to run together as one run. Each entry is resolved and run exactly like an entry in Maestro.run/1's own list.

examples.name: Nightly Regression
examples.description: Every suite that must pass before a nightly deploy.
